[[File:Bubo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The frog-dog was a sentient amphibicanoid.]]
An '''amphibicanoid''' was a class of life to which [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Frog-dog/Legends|frog-dogs]] belonged.<ref name="Wolf">{{StoryCite|story=Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke|book=SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The term "amphibicanoid" was introduced in reference to the frog-dog in the short story "[[Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke]]," written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="Wolf" /> on [[March 6]]th, [[2015]].<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/52204636|board=Literature|thread=Abel G. Peña's "Skyewalkers" and "Lone Wolf"|user=[[John Hazlett|jSarek]]|date=2015-05-11|time=8:59 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160831095014/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/abel-g-pe%C3%B1as-skyewalkers-and-lone-wolf.50027998/}}</ref> A frog-dog first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]<ref name="VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> on [[May 25]]th, [[1983]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref>
